free_tier_limits: No free API tier; API access requires an active Luma Plus subscription for the calendar.
rate_limits: 200 requests per minute per calendar for calendar API keys and OAuth tokens; 500 requests per minute per organization for organization API keys.
resolution_notes: base_url: corrected; official base URL is https://public-api.luma.com (https://docs.luma.com/reference/getting-started-with-your-api). free_tier_limits: corrected; Luma Plus is required for API access (same URL; https://luma.com/pricing). rate_limits: corrected to current per-minute limits (https://docs.luma.com/reference/rate-limits). example: corrected to Luma's documented get-self curl using x-luma-api-key (https://docs.luma.com/reference/getting-started-with-your-api).
